svg.title: Practice chanter, a measured chanter's holes as slots on a 8mm octagonal bore of eight finger-jointed strips, sheet 1 of 1
svg.desc: 1 user unit = 1mm. Practice chanter, a measured chanter's holes as slots on a 8mm octagonal bore of eight finger-jointed strips, sheet 1 of 1. 3mm ply, drawn for a 0.13mm kerf. Orange #ff8000 cuts the bores, seats, slots and pin holes first; then black #000000 frees the plates.
